surface_mechanism_description: The migration growth occurring with the ALD technique decreases chemical disorder by decreasing the number of dangling bonds and unstable bonds at the grain boundaries of the ZnO films, making oxygen chemisorption at the grain boundaries difficult, and thereby prevents deterioration in the electrical properties of the films.
evidence: It can be supposed that the migration growth occurring with the ALD technique decreases chemical disorder by decreasing the number of dangling bonds and unstable bonds at the grain boundaries of the ZnO films, making oxygen chemisorption at the grain boundaries difficult, and thereby prevents deterioration in the electrical properties of the films.
